backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor serving as the backend entry point with no implemented functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two completed features: removal of scroll-based parallax/animation effects and changing hero section background to white, both targeting HeroSection.tsx with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files describing a Spanish-language BlueFire cybersecurity website for Mexican PYMEs and maquiladoras with hero, services, market context, workflow, pilot program, contact sections and footer.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining light and dark mode CSS variables for a cybersecurity-themed design system including primary, secondary, accent, chart, and sidebar colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with Spanish language attribute, SEO meta tags for BlueFire cybersecurity targeting Mexican PYMEs and maquiladoras, and root div for React mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component that renders the complete single-page BlueFire website by composing all section components (Hero, Services, MarketContext, TargetClients, Workflow, PilotProgram, Contact, Footer) in sequence.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Contact section component with Angel Medina's contact information cards (email, phone, location) and a frontend-only contact form with Spanish labels and temporary success message display.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying BlueFire branding, services list, contact information, copyright with dynamic year, and caffeine.ai attribution link with UTM tracking using hostname as app identifier.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero section component with BlueFire branding on clean white background, Spanish tagline about cybersecurity protection for Mexico, two CTA buttons for evaluation and services, and three key statistics (40B+ attacks, 74% ransomware, 99.8% PYMEs).
frontend/src/components/MarketContextSec: Market context section displaying Mexico's cybersecurity threat landscape with four statistics cards, sector breakdown visualization (finance 31%, health 21%, manufacturing 19%), PYME vulnerability alert, and supporting infographic image.
frontend/src/components/PilotProgramSect: React component displaying a pilot program offering for a 48-hour vulnerability scanning service, including process steps, deliverables, pricing ($1,500 USD), and optional add-on services like remediation and monthly retainers.
React component showcasing four core cybersecurity services (Asset Registry, Vulnerability Assessment, Remediation, Network Segmentation) with descriptions, necessity justifications for the Mexican market, and benefits for each service.
frontend/src/components/TargetClientsSec: React component presenting target client segments (SMEs and Maquiladoras) with their characteristics, sales cycle differences, and four client types including local SMEs, manufacturing plants, supply chain providers, and MSPs.
React component outlining the four-stage workflow process (Asset Registry, Vulnerability Assessment, Patching, Segmentation) with detailed stages for each, plus an integrated workflow diagram for IT/OT environments.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages an actor instance for backend communication, handling both authenticated and anonymous actors based on Internet Identity state, with automatic query invalidation on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React hook and context provider for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options for ICP-based authentication.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with cybersecurity-themed color palette using CSS custom properties for light and dark modes, featuring deep blue/cyan primary colors and chart visualization variables.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React application entry point that sets up QueryClient, InternetIdentityProvider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending the theme with custom colors (using oklch color space), typography, container queries, animations, and cybersecurity-themed design tokens including glow effects and custom fonts.
project_state.json: Project metadata defining a Spanish-language presentation website for BlueFire cybersecurity consulting company targeting Mexican PYMEs and manufacturing plants, with features for hero section, services, market context, target clients, workflow, and contact sections.
